correctness.rationale: Rank-one trace duality and concavity are independently supported by Levene Lemmas 2.3/2.5. The affine group orbit count gives one row orbit and two column orbits; the independently reconstructed Gram decomposition has multiplicities q^2-1, q, 1 summing to q(q+1). Strict concavity and endpoint derivatives prove uniqueness and mass rigidity; exact first variation at uniform weights is negative. Perturbative critical equation gives q^-1-2q^-2+6q^-3, the norm expansion and both sharp gap constants. Numerical singular systems were checked on actual incidence matrices for q=2,3,5,7, but these are supplemental.

value.rationale: Line deletion is the natural smallest perturbation of a finite projective-plane incidence Schur projection. Its exact norm, universal nonuniform extremizing mass, and distinct q^-3/2 deletion versus q^-5/2 reweighting costs resolve a meaningful family-wide matrix norm sensitivity problem, rather than a generic one-off numerical invariant.
